list.name: models
list.label: Models (multi)
list.definition:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
schema.tagValues(bucket:"${bucket}", tag:"model", start: 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z)
|> filter(fn: (r) => r._value !~ /^[0-9.]+$/)
list.query:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
schema.tagValues(bucket:"${bucket}", tag:"model", start: 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z)
|> filter(fn: (r) => r._value !~ /^[0-9.]+$/)

panels.title: Champion overlay — ACTUAL vs PREDICTION + |pred−act| ribbon

targets.query:
from(bucket:"${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn:(r)=> r.model == "${active_model}")
  |> filter(fn:(r)=> r._field == "actual" or r._field == "prediction")
|> filter(fn:(r)=> r.TerminalID =~ /${terminal:regex}/)
|> filter(fn:(r)=> r.MoveType   =~ /${movetype:regex}/)
|> filter(fn:(r)=> r.Desig      =~ /${desig:regex}/)
|> map(fn:(r)=> ({ r with _value: float(v:r._value) }))
|> group(columns: ["model","_field"])
|> aggregateWindow(every: ${window}, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)

import "math"
a = from(bucket:"${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn:(r)=> r.model == "${active_model}" and r._field == "actual")
|> filter(fn:(r)=> r.TerminalID =~ /${terminal:regex}/)
|> filter(fn:(r)=> r.MoveType   =~ /${movetype:regex}/)
|> filter(fn:(r)=> r.Desig      =~ /${desig:regex}/)
  |> map(fn:(r)=> ({ r with _value: float(v:r._value) }))
  |> group(columns: ["model"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: ${window}, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time","_value","model"])

p = from(bucket:"${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn:(r)=> r.model == "${active_model}" and r._field == "prediction")
|> filter(fn:(r)=> r.TerminalID =~ /${terminal:regex}/)
|> filter(fn:(r)=> r.MoveType   =~ /${movetype:regex}/)
|> filter(fn:(r)=> r.Desig      =~ /${desig:regex}/)
  |> map(fn:(r)=> ({ r with _value: float(v:r._value) }))
  |> group(columns: ["model"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: ${window}, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time","_value","model"])

join(tables:{a:a, b:p}, on: ["_time","model"])
  |> map(fn:(r)=> ({ r with _field:"abs_error", _value: math.abs(x: r._value_b - r._value_a) }))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time","_field","_value"])

from(bucket:"${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn:(r)=> r.model == "${active_model}" and r._field == "mape")
|> filter(fn:(r)=> r.TerminalID =~ /${terminal:regex}/)
|> filter(fn:(r)=> r.MoveType   =~ /${movetype:regex}/)
|> filter(fn:(r)=> r.Desig      =~ /${desig:regex}/)
|> map(fn:(r)=> ({ r with _value: float(v:r._value) }))
|> aggregateWindow(every: 1h, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
|> last()

from(bucket:"${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn:(r)=> r.model == "${active_model}" and r._field == "accuracy")
|> filter(fn:(r)=> r.TerminalID =~ /${terminal:regex}/)
|> filter(fn:(r)=> r.MoveType   =~ /${movetype:regex}/)
|> filter(fn:(r)=> r.Desig      =~ /${desig:regex}/)
|> map(fn:(r)=> ({ r with _value: float(v:r._value) }))
|> aggregateWindow(every: 1h, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
|> last()

import "math"
from(bucket:"${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn:(r)=> r.model == "${active_model}" and r._field == "error")
|> filter(fn:(r)=> r.TerminalID =~ /${terminal:regex}/)
|> filter(fn:(r)=> r.MoveType   =~ /${movetype:regex}/)
|> filter(fn:(r)=> r.Desig      =~ /${desig:regex}/)
|> map(fn:(r)=> ({ r with _value: float(v:r._value) }))
|> aggregateWindow(every: 1h, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
|> map(fn:(r)=> ({ r with _value: if math.abs(x:r._value) <= float(v:${tol}) then 1.0 else 0.0 }))
|> mean()
|> map(fn:(r)=> ({ r with _value: r._value * 100.0 }))

panels.title: Cross‑model — Predictions vs Champion ACTUAL baseline

targets.query:
// Actual baseline from champion
act = from(bucket:"${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn:(r)=> r._field == "actual" and r.model == "${active_model}")
|> filter(fn:(r)=> r.TerminalID =~ /${terminal:regex}/)
|> filter(fn:(r)=> r.MoveType   =~ /${movetype:regex}/)
|> filter(fn:(r)=> r.Desig      =~ /${desig:regex}/)
  |> map(fn:(r)=> ({ r with _value: float(v:r._value), model: "actual" }))
  |> group(columns: ["model"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: ${window}, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)

// Predictions for selected models
pred = from(bucket:"${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn:(r)=> r._field == "prediction")
  |> filter(fn:(r)=> r.model =~ /${models:regex}/)
|> filter(fn:(r)=> r.TerminalID =~ /${terminal:regex}/)
|> filter(fn:(r)=> r.MoveType   =~ /${movetype:regex}/)
|> filter(fn:(r)=> r.Desig      =~ /${desig:regex}/)
  |> map(fn:(r)=> ({ r with _value: float(v:r._value) }))
  |> group(columns: ["model"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: ${window}, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)

union(tables:[act, pred])

panels.title: Grouped bars — avg ${bar_metric} (mean) & ACTUAL volume share (%)

targets.query:
// Avg error metric per model
m = from(bucket:"${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn:(r)=> r._field == "${bar_metric}")
  |> filter(fn:(r)=> r.model =~ /${models:regex}/)
|> filter(fn:(r)=> r.TerminalID =~ /${terminal:regex}/)
|> filter(fn:(r)=> r.MoveType   =~ /${movetype:regex}/)
|> filter(fn:(r)=> r.Desig      =~ /${desig:regex}/)
  |> map(fn:(r)=> ({ r with _value: float(v:r._value) }))
  |> group(columns:["model"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every:${window}, fn: mean, createEmpty:false)
  |> mean()
  |> map(fn:(r)=> ({ r with metric:"error_"+ "${bar_metric}", val:r._value }))
  |> keep(columns:["model","metric","val"])

// Volume share from champion ACTUAL
v = from(bucket:"${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn:(r)=> r.model == "${active_model}" and r._field == "actual")
|> filter(fn:(r)=> r.TerminalID =~ /${terminal:regex}/)
|> filter(fn:(r)=> r.MoveType   =~ /${movetype:regex}/)
|> filter(fn:(r)=> r.Desig      =~ /${desig:regex}/)
  |> map(fn:(r)=> ({ r with _value: float(v:r._value) }))
  |> group()
  |> aggregateWindow(every:${window}, fn: sum, createEmpty:false)
vt = v |> group() |> sum(column:"_value")
      |> map(fn:(r)=> ({ r with key:"k", total:r._value }))
      |> keep(columns:["key","total"])
v2 = v |> map(fn:(r)=> ({ r with key:"k"}))
j = join(tables:{a:v2, b:vt}, on:["key"])
    |> map(fn:(r)=> ({ r with metric:"volume_pct", val:(r._value / r.total)*100.0, model:"actual_volume" }))
    |> keep(columns:["model","metric","val"])

union(tables:[m, j])
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey:["model"], columnKey:["metric"], valueColumn:"val")

import "date"
src_err = from(bucket:"${bucket}")
  |> range(start:v.timeRangeStart, stop:v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn:(r)=> r._field=="error")
|> filter(fn:(r)=> r.TerminalID =~ /${terminal:regex}/)
|> filter(fn:(r)=> r.MoveType   =~ /${movetype:regex}/)
|> filter(fn:(r)=> r.Desig      =~ /${desig:regex}/)
  |> map(fn:(r)=> ({ r with _value: float(v:r._value) }))
  |> group()
  |> aggregateWindow(every:${window}, fn: mean, createEmpty:false)
  |> map(fn:(r)=> ({ r with hour: string(v: date.hour(t: r._time)), weekday: string(v: date.weekDay(t: r._time)), kind: "error" }))
  |> keep(columns:["hour","weekday","_value","kind"])

src_act = from(bucket:"${bucket}")
  |> range(start:v.timeRangeStart, stop:v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn:(r)=> r.model == "${active_model}" and r._field=="actual")
|> filter(fn:(r)=> r.TerminalID =~ /${terminal:regex}/)
|> filter(fn:(r)=> r.MoveType   =~ /${movetype:regex}/)
|> filter(fn:(r)=> r.Desig      =~ /${desig:regex}/)
  |> map(fn:(r)=> ({ r with _value: float(v:r._value) }))
  |> group()
  |> aggregateWindow(every:${window}, fn: sum, createEmpty:false)
  |> map(fn:(r)=> ({ r with hour: string(v: date.hour(t: r._time)), weekday: string(v: date.weekDay(t: r._time)), kind: "actual" }))
  |> keep(columns:["hour","weekday","_value","kind"])

union(tables:[src_err, src_act])
  |> filter(fn:(r)=> r.kind == "${heatmap_kind}")
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey:["hour"], columnKey:["weekday"], valueColumn:"_value")
  |> sort(columns:["hour"], desc:false)

panels.title: Details — hourly (SUM actual/pred, MEAN errors) — champion actual only

targets.query:
a = from(bucket:"${bucket}")
  |> range(start:v.timeRangeStart, stop:v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn:(r)=> r.model == "${active_model}" and r._field=="actual")
|> filter(fn:(r)=> r.TerminalID =~ /${terminal:regex}/)
|> filter(fn:(r)=> r.MoveType   =~ /${movetype:regex}/)
|> filter(fn:(r)=> r.Desig      =~ /${desig:regex}/)
  |> map(fn:(r)=> ({ r with _value: float(v:r._value) }))
  |> group()
  |> aggregateWindow(every:1h, fn: sum, createEmpty:false)

p = from(bucket:"${bucket}")
  |> range(start:v.timeRangeStart, stop:v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn:(r)=> r._field=="prediction")
  |> filter(fn:(r)=> r.model =~ /${models:regex}/)
|> filter(fn:(r)=> r.TerminalID =~ /${terminal:regex}/)
|> filter(fn:(r)=> r.MoveType   =~ /${movetype:regex}/)
|> filter(fn:(r)=> r.Desig      =~ /${desig:regex}/)
  |> map(fn:(r)=> ({ r with _value: float(v:r._value) }))
  |> group(columns:["model"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every:1h, fn: sum, createEmpty:false)

errs = from(bucket:"${bucket}")
  |> range(start:v.timeRangeStart, stop:v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn:(r)=> r._field=="error" or r._field=="mse" or r._field=="rmse" or r._field=="mae" or r._field=="mape" or r._field=="accuracy")
  |> filter(fn:(r)=> r.model =~ /${models:regex}/)
|> filter(fn:(r)=> r.TerminalID =~ /${terminal:regex}/)
|> filter(fn:(r)=> r.MoveType   =~ /${movetype:regex}/)
|> filter(fn:(r)=> r.Desig      =~ /${desig:regex}/)
  |> map(fn:(r)=> ({ r with _value: float(v:r._value) }))
  |> group(columns:["model","_field"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every:1h, fn: mean, createEmpty:false)

union(tables:[a,p,errs])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time","model"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time","model","actual","prediction","error","mse","rmse","mae","mape","accuracy"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 300)

from(bucket:"${bucket}")
  |> range(start:v.timeRangeStart, stop:v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn:(r)=> r.model == "${active_model}" and r._field=="error")
|> filter(fn:(r)=> r.TerminalID =~ /${terminal:regex}/)
|> filter(fn:(r)=> r.MoveType   =~ /${movetype:regex}/)
|> filter(fn:(r)=> r.Desig      =~ /${desig:regex}/)
|> map(fn:(r)=> ({ r with _value: float(v:r._value) }))
|> group(columns:["model"])
|> aggregateWindow(every:1h, fn: mean, createEmpty:false)
|> cumulativeSum(columns: ["_value"])
|> last()

panels.title: Tier distribution (hours by ACTUAL volume, champion)

targets.query:
import "math"
from(bucket:"${bucket}")
  |> range(start:v.timeRangeStart, stop:v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn:(r)=> r.model == "${active_model}" and r._field=="actual")
|> filter(fn:(r)=> r.TerminalID =~ /${terminal:regex}/)
|> filter(fn:(r)=> r.MoveType   =~ /${movetype:regex}/)
|> filter(fn:(r)=> r.Desig      =~ /${desig:regex}/)
|> map(fn:(r)=> ({ r with _value: float(v:r._value) }))
|> group()
|> aggregateWindow(every:1h, fn: sum, createEmpty:false)
|> map(fn:(r)=> ({ r with tier: if r._value < float(v:${tier1}) then "green <" + string(v:${tier1}) else if r._value < float(v:${tier2}) then "orange " + string(v:${tier1}) + "-" + string(v:${tier2}-1) else "red ≥" + string(v:${tier2}) }))
|> group(columns:["tier"])
|> count()
|> keep(columns:["tier","_value"])

import "math"

  |> range(start:v.timeRangeStart, stop:v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn:(r)=> r.model == "${active_model}" and r._field=="actual")

|> filter(fn:(r)=> r.Desig      =~ /${desig:regex}/)

|> group(columns:["tier"])
|> count()
|> group()
|> pivot(rowKey:["tier"], columnKey:["tier"], valueColumn:"_value")
